extended: recall-before-dispatch; opcode fetch observes extended table as well
notes: Allowlist describes executed commands only, not unreachable branches.
Actor commands require a second check on the resolved actor before commit.
All non-allowlisted opcodes retain native execution after immediate recall.
The field X menu is admitted by its native menu flag and exact event identity; child applications retain conservative recall.
The audited PC box opcode preserves one bounded actor pose in the resident bridge across its no-fade field restart.
0x1D9 edits pending zone NPC placement data only. Native allocation and initial-position notifications retain destination conflict checks; it never moves a live actor.

0x276 reports ordinary interaction progress to the Funfest mission subsystem. Stock sign and furniture scripts execute it after pausing actors; it does not move actors, replace the field, or start a communication activity.
PVPlay's child callback is allowed only while its work points to the live script VM and parent event that issued the cry. Sound-only commands do not alter follower state.

The September command audit admits direct state queries, word formatting, synchronous ambience control, and isolated save-data writes. Scripted movement, party mutations, child applications, field teardown, event-driven music transitions, and commands with unresolved side effects remain excluded; native actor and callback guards still apply.
PVPlayEx uses the same child callback and work layout as PVPlay, including the live-script ownership guard. Event-driven BGM transitions remain excluded because they create different child callbacks.
